fusions.name: Shoal Swell
fusions.desc: Surges a wave out from you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles (max 32%).

fusions.name: Slipstream Gore
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to an enemy and gores it, which deals 14 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You then move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Hide
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 15 seconds. It also pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Reading the Current
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. It also hardens your armour by 6% at all times.
